_comment: The ONLY hand-maintained component data. Everything else in component-status.json is derived from the filesystem by scripts/audit-components.js. A `wont-port` entry MUST carry a reason — it is surfaced in the migration guide and should be surfaced in a runtime error too. `node scripts/audit-components.js --check` fails if an entry names a component that no longer exists.

Effects.reason: Wraps three-stdlib's EffectComposer, which is WebGL-only. WebGPU postprocessing goes through three's own RenderPipeline (useRenderPipeline in r3f v10), which is a different architecture rather than a port of this one.

AsciiRenderer.reason: Wraps three-stdlib's AsciiEffect, a WebGL-only DOM overlay effect with no WebGPU equivalent upstream.

shaderMaterial.reason: A factory for GLSL ShaderMaterials. TSL's equivalent is node-graph construction, a fundamentally different authoring model — WebGPU users write TSL directly rather than calling a GLSL factory.

useBoxProjectedEnv.reason: Implemented by patching a built-in material's GLSL through onBeforeCompile. TSL has no onBeforeCompile equivalent; box-projected environment mapping on WebGPU would be a new node-based implementation, not a port.

ShadowAlpha.reason: Patches the depth material's GLSL through onBeforeCompile to carry alpha into shadows. Same constraint as useBoxProjectedEnv — needs a new TSL implementation rather than a port.

Text.reason: Depended on a vendored troika fork that could not be published. Returns via @pmndrs/glyph, which covers both renderers. Tracked in #2658.

MeshDiscardMaterial.reason: The heuristic flags this human-only because the legacy file uses ShaderMaterial, but that is exactly what gets replaced. webgpu/DiscardMaterial already exists; this is a NodeMaterial with discard() in TSL plus the same thin JSX wrapper. Mechanical.

BakeShadows.reason: src/webgpu/Staging/BakeShadows is byte-identical to the legacy file (copied in #2599 so the /webgpu barrel had something to export) and is a silent no-op there: WebGPURenderer.shadowMap is { enabled, transmitted, type } with no autoUpdate/needsUpdate (three/src/renderers/common/Renderer.js:703). WebGPU controls this per-light via light.shadow.autoUpdate/needsUpdate (ShadowNode.js:855), so the port traverses the scene rather than touching the renderer. Tracked in #2665.
